description.value: Rel-ish Bistro is a scratch-kitchen restaurant and bar on Nelson's main street, known for a West Coast take on comfort classics using locally sourced, often organic ingredients from Kootenay-region farms. Chef Jeremy Lerch draws on family recipes and seasonal produce, with a menu spanning breakfast through evening mains alongside a craft beer and BC wine selection. The restaurant also offers catering and an online store featuring house-made preserves and sauces.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 69m; stands (2 spaces) at 75m. Total: 4 spaces.
